title: Beartooth releases new tracks, but they're only available in Japan.
contentHtml:
Beartooth, a metalcore band from Columbus, Ohio has released 3 new exclusive tracks on the Japanese version of their first LP “Disgusting.” Tracks include ‘Finish Line’, ‘Give It Up’, and a live version of ‘Blitzkrieg Bop’ by The Ramones. Sadly enough without a torrent or an illegal download you cannot access these songs as of now unless you find them on YouTube.
I can only imagine that these bonus tracks will be available in a short time in other countries, but for now stay legal my friends and as always stay metal.
